n01.roman: Ek naya, 4 seat wala chhota helicopter lo: Robinson R44 Raven II.

n02.roman: America ke ek authorized Robinson dealer ke mutabik, 1 January 2026 se iski base keemat hai 6,46,000 dollar.

n03.roman: Rupaye mein? Kareeb 6 crore! Aur ye sirf America ki base keemat hai, options jodo toh aur zyada.

n04.roman: Itne mein 160 se zyada Alto K10 aa jaayen, Delhi ki ex-showroom keemat par!

n05.roman: Twist: isi paise mein GTA 6 ki 10 hazaar se zyada copies aa jaayen!

n06.roman: Matlab helicopter wala shauq, game mein hi sabse sasta hai!
